title: Indigo V3 – CNT-Backed Collateral for Indigo CDPs

ms.promise:
・Updated iAsset, CDP, Governance, Treasury, Staking, and Stability Pool smart contracts to support Cardano Native Token (CNT)-backed collateral.
・On-chain logic for collateral whitelisting, risk parameters (discount rates, oracles), and multi-asset interest and fee handling.
・Positive and negative test cases for ADA and non-ADA CDPs.
・Technical Specification document outlining the changes to the contracts required to fulfill the CNT-backed collateral, as well as planned tests for CNT-backed collateral.
ms.criteria:
・All smart contracts compile successfully in Aiken.
・Full test-suite passes for both ADA and CNT-based CDPs.
・Collateral ratio, interest, liquidation, and redemption calculations function correctly for multiple collateral types.
・Test suite achieves minimum 90% code coverage across all updated contract modules.
ms.report:
Technical Specifications Document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OdPNDJsmijxYdmLObMEZtpHaiMe5iT9R/view?usp=sharing
The technical specifications document begins by outlining the changes that will be required to be made to the existing v2.1 Indigo smart contracts, at the end of the document, we outline all of the tests that are planned to be implemented.
Mapping of acceptance criteria:
1) Updated iAsset, CDP, Governance, Treasury, Staking, and Stability Pool smart contracts to support Cardano Native Token (CNT)-backed collateral.
In the technical specifications document, we outline all of the ty[e and rule changes required to support the Cardano Native Token backed collateral. Specifically the implementation details of the Assets script (iAssets), CDP script (CDP), Governance script (Governance), and Stability Pool script (Stability Pool). No changes ended up being required for the Treasury contract for the purpose of Cardano Native Token backed collateral.
・Assets Script - page 1 - 3
・CDP script - page 3 - 8
・Governance - page 8 - 10
・Stability Pool - page 10 - 14

2) On-chain logic for collateral whitelisting, risk parameters (discount rates, oracles), and multi-asset interest and fee handling.
The on-chain logic for collateral whitelisting happens through governance, specifically if you look at the “ProposalContent” we have added AddCollateralAsset and UpdateCollateralAsset types, the rules for these changes are described in the “Collateral Assets” section of Governance in the Technical Specifications.
Reference pages: 8 - 10
The exact parameters for a CollateralAsset, can be found at the end of page 1, spanning into page 2 of the technical specification:
・iasset: AssetClass
・collateral_asset: AssetClass
・price_info: IAssetPriceInfo
・interest_oracle_nft: AssetClass
・redemption_ratio_percentage: OnChainDecimal
・maintenance_ratio_percentage: OnChainDecimal
・liquidation_ratio_percentage: OnChainDecimal
・min_collateral_amt: Integer
・first_collateral_asset: Bool
・nex

ms.report:
Mainnet Deployment & Governance Execution
A. Output: Deployment of Updated Indigo V3 Contracts to Cardano Mainnet

Acceptance criteria:
・Mainnet deployment verified via on-chain transactions.
・Script hashes on-chain match audited code.

Evidence:
Indigo V3 was successfully deployed to Cardano Mainnet and activated through the Indigo protocol upgrade process.
Link to proposal: https://app.indigoprotocol.io/indy-dao/118
The upgrade began with deployment of the VERSION_RECORD UTxO:
・VERSION_RECORD deployment: https://cexplorer.io/tx/dff0c30bfb0d48178171ef12c4fd06f5c9c1f25bfa54a734bcbbf66da2e4fac6

The VERSION_RECORD datum contains the upgrade instructions used by Indigo v2.1 contracts to migrate protocol state to the Indigo V3 architecture.
Example upgrade transactions include:
・iUSD iAsset upgrade: https://cexplorer.io/tx/fc0a11f80f20cf6925a8793065e828c77ccba9909d173eb7e2521a8d236bea2e
・iUSD Stability Pool upgrade: https://cexplorer.io/tx/46cc8c843009c6ecf90d21a7d5af6228b51191bdd89e389767451418944cfe5f

The iUSD iAsset upgrade creates the V3 iAsset representation and the initial iUSD/ADA collateral asset. The Stability Pool upgrade additionally migrated the pool from epoch 1 to epoch 0 as part of the V3 architecture.
